title: Vivaldi browser profiles
whyItMatters: Each Vivaldi profile holds history, sessions, mail accounts and saved logins. The profiles show who used the browser and what they were doing.
source: BrowserForensics, Brave/Opera/Vivaldi profile locations: Vivaldi on Linux keeps profiles under ~/.config/vivaldi/<profile>: https://www.browserforensics.app/en/blog/brave-opera-vivaldi-profile-locations
notes: Vivaldi is Chromium-based; the directory is lowercase vivaldi and profiles are Default, Profile 1, ... Matches the Preferences marker file. Vivaldi Snapshot uses a separate vivaldi-snapshot tree and is not matched.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Vivaldi, export your bookmarks from the bookmark manager and your passwords from the password settings, and keep both files off this computer.
cleanup.signOut: In Vivaldi, open Settings > Sync and sign out of your Vivaldi account, so the synced data stays in the account.
steps: Uninstall Vivaldi from the App Center if you are removing the browser itself.
Move the folder named in the plan to the Trash and empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Removes every Vivaldi profile on this computer: history, bookmarks, saved passwords, cookies, notes and open sessions.
cleanup.source: Vivaldi Help, How to uninstall Vivaldi: https://help.vivaldi.com/desktop/install-update/how-to-uninstall-vivaldi/
